reply: Thank you for clarifying—cream sauces are a taste preference, not an intolerance. Enjoy your time in Paris together, Theo; we look forward to welcoming you and Gabriel.

threads.detail: Marking five years since their civil partnership; Monday dinner booked elsewhere, Tuesday evening open.
Neither wants decorations, notes or anniversary surprises.
Welcome a relaxed bistro recommendation, neither formal nor drawn-out. Gabriel loves cheese; Theo avoids heavy cream sauces as a taste preference, not an intolerance.
Tuesday afternoon meeting; expects to be free by 6:30. Other days are shared leisure time.

Gabriel loves architecture and is visiting Paris for the first time. Theo browses secondhand poetry books and has visited for work. Enjoy long bistro lunches; welcome pointers but prefer wandering to a timed route.
Gabriel reads late while Theo falls asleep early; a reading light away from Theo's pillow would help in their shared room.
